title: Whittaker's Chocolate Block Varieties 200g-250g $7.00 @ BIG W
body:
Deal: Whittaker's Chocolate Block Varieties 200g-250g $7.00 @ BIG W

[hornoscous] It really sucks that $7 is a bargain these days but it not getting any cheaper so take my money big w and give me creamy milk…
[Sebajun] I'm with you. I haven't pulled the trigger yet. At $6 I'd go for it. $7 still stings a little bit IMHO.
[CheapCookie] It's like every time I blink at them, they go up in price.
Whittaker's seem to be the last standing "reasonably priced" chocolate bar producer that actually makes good chocolate still.
I know in my soul that they too will eventually fall to greed and become like Cadbury, this is just how the story goes…
[goodwillN1] Agreed. I will keep buying them even if they keep going up. Just less. If they change the chocolate to keep the price I would stop buying them altogether.
[ConsumerOfPumpkinPie] Think the worst I've seen this at is $10.80 at a Woolies Metro. I'll take it for $7 but I'll still be crying at the self-serve
[Haunt] Just sooo hard to resist grabbing a bar or two of Hokey Pokey Crunch and Peanut Butter, they are too good, last good haul I got was like almost 2 years ago at $6 a pop with extra 10% off at Big W :(
[lovrekn] $9 chocolate discounted to $7 is hardly ‘bargain’ territory
[M00Cow] Yes there's no excuse for chocolate prices to keep skyrocketing. The price of cocoa halved earlier this year compared to the previous 18 months so the price should have gone down. Now it's going up. They'll make that an excuse to keep going up.
[lordezekiel] Let me guess, a $900 gpu discounted to $700 is though?
[LukeOz83] Thats 22% discount.
Still better value and quality than Cadbury.
[Hypnotoad] I was in Dunedin last week and it’s still cheaper to buy Whittaker’s over here than there, which is so weird.
[lost in transit] It’s the same with our products overseas 🤷‍♂️🤷‍♂️
[LukeOz83] True, but apart from 33% cumulative inflation, we also have to add about 60-80% increase in cocoa market price, which will bring it to $8.50 to $9.50 in the current rate.
[Headless] Used to be, but prices only follow an upward trend these days despite much a lower cocoa price today
[Headless] This is NZ chocolate, not Cadbury or china supplied
